objections.text: The hand-derived fixed case 'table maximum equals the unused sequence's start value' already calls OrderID with an unused sequence whose start equals the table maximum and requires a restart at maximum + 1. A08 repeats that same input relationship and branch with start and maximum 7; using the unrelated StockItemID sequence first does not change the OrderID attack.
objections.resolution: A08 now uses an OrderID sequence that has issued three values, so current value 7 comes from last_value rather than from an unused sequence's start. This distinguishes current-value handling from the hand-derived unused-sequence boundary.
